signatures.name: fabric-api
signatures.title: Fabric API is missing
signatures.body: Fabric mods require Fabric API mod to be installed separately. You can find it on CurseForge or Modrinth. Don't forget you need to pick one that matches your Minecraft version.

signatures.name: char-png
signatures.title: Skin shouldn't be changed that way
signatures.body: Minecraft has crashed because you failed to change skin properly. We suggest you use another method: just register on Ely.by, return to the launcher and use your new account to launch the game. To fix the crash check "Force update" in the main menu next time you try to launch the game.

signatures.name: no-lwjgl32-on-linux
signatures.title: Linux x86 not supported
signatures.body:
LWJGL 3 developers dropped Linux x86 support.
You may install 64-bit version of your distro, or just play older version of Minecraft.

signatures.name: bug-mc-129374
signatures.title: MC-129374
signatures.body:
Minecraft is crashed due to the error specified in the bug tracker: MC-129374.

Java for x86 systems has smaller stack size, that is only 32-bit system users are affected by this issue.

signatures.name: old-forge-newer-java
signatures.title: Old Forge version
signatures.body:
Newer Java don't support old Forge versions. Use Java 8 to run Forge versions that came out before Minecraft 1.17.

Make sure "Recommended" JVM is selected in the launcher settings.

signatures.name: llibrary-missing
signatures.title: LLibrary is missing
signatures.body: One of the installed mods require LLibrary. Download on CurseForge and install it.

signatures.body: Memory Allocation Stack limit exceeded. You can try increasing the limit using button below or remove a mod caused the issue (most likely, VulkanMod).

signatures.name: system-oom
signatures.pattern: ^# There is insufficient memory for the Java Runtime Environment to continue\.$
signatures.title: Insufficient memory
signatures.body: There was insufficient memory for Minecraft to continue. Close all other applications on the system. Decrease memory amount in the launcher settings.
